name: Tidio
oneLiner: Customer service platform for small and midsize businesses combining live chat, the Lyro AI agent, Flows automation and a help desk.
bestFor: Small and midsize businesses, including restaurants, that want a website chat widget with an AI agent and no coding.

updates.text: Tidio reported that Lyro ranked first in the default view of G2's AI CX Agent Evaluations (as of October 7, 2026), with the highest policy-compliance score among the agents evaluated.
Lyro extended to email ticketing (Tidio product news; no date confirmed, not used in review).

features: Live chat widget for websites with mobile and desktop apps for agents
Lyro AI agent that answers questions from your knowledge base and website
Lyro handoff to a human agent
Flows: visual no-code automation for greetings, lead capture and FAQs
Help desk ticketing for email, with Lyro on email tickets
Integrations with Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp
Analytics on conversations and AI resolutions

pricing.text: Free plan available; Starter $24.17 per month billed annually ($29 monthly); Growth from $49.17 per month billed annually; Plus custom; Lyro AI agent sold as an add-on based on AI conversations.
